blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The University of San Jose-Recoletos (USJ-R) Jaguars stunned the favored University of Cebu (UC) Webmasters, 71-55, in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday, November 15, at the Cebu Coliseum. The Jaguars, coached by former PBA star Roger Yap, boosted their Final Four bid with their seventh win against five losses, good for fifth place in the standings. They are just one game behind the fourth-running CIT-U Wildcats (8-4), with four games remaining in the elimination round.
